meta.frame: body: x forward, y left, z up; origin = CAD origin; floor z = ground.crawler_bottom_z_m
meta.signs: pitch > 0 nose-down, roll > 0 left up; q about the body-frame origin
meta.level: auger top (mass case C) unless noted; legs = superstructure + 4 moving parts

assumptions.dashpot total: 2 zeta sqrt(kn_total m), m = superstructure top + 4 moving parts, split equally over the floor-contact points

left_rear.role: end wheel rear (-Z_cad): idler or sprocket

left_front.role: end wheel front (+Z_cad): idler or sprocket

right_rear.role: end wheel rear (-Z_cad): idler or sprocket

right_front.role: end wheel front (+Z_cad): idler or sprocket

A_current_2x9_bbox.note: YAML contact.crawler.sphere_layout: x evenly over the crawler bbox, y +/-1.066 (assumed 0.6 m shoe)

B_rollers_2x6.note: lower track roller axes from crawler_wheels.csv, y = track centre +/-1.045 (crawler_summary.json)

C_flat_shoes_2x10.note: grouser pad centres touching the floor (lowest point 0 mm), pitch 173.2 mm

D_rollers_plus_gapped_end_shoes.note: B + raised shoes beyond the end rollers (gap = CAD lowest point, k per point = B value): end engagement upper bound

E_rollers_2x6_k_x3.note: B with kn_total x 3 (stiffer track/slab), dashpot rescaled to the same heave zeta

F_D_with_k_x3.note: D with kn_total x 3 (stiffer track/slab), dashpot rescaled to the same heave zeta

levelling_range_crawler_clearance.envelope_note: lowest point per 10 mm (x, y) cell over the crawler solids' bboxes (conservative: each solid fills its bbox); the raised track ends and the idler/sprocket wraps replace the floor-level bbox corners
